To measure your speed we use M-Lab (Measurement Lab) servers, an open Internet research platform supported by Google.

M-Lab stores and publishes each test result as open data, together with your public IP address (the one of your Internet connection, not your phone's address on your network). Your name, email and anything about your local network are not sent.
